summary.en: Rumi Wakasa is the class 1-B's new deputy homeroom teacher. She seems to be very clumsy, leaving a funny first impression as she knocked her head on the desk while bowing to say "Nice to meet you". She asks the Detective Boys to go with her to the shed to bring quick lime, admitting that she is scared of going there alone. A 10-year-old bare-bone corpse is discovered there by Wakasa and the Detective Boys. A skeleton was found in the storage shed of Teitan Elementary School. Wakasa Rumi wants a lime that is found there. Upon arriving, the Detective Boys searched the storage shed, and Conan found a trapdoor that leads to a basement. It turns out there was a skeleton leaning on the ground with string with characters in hand. The police are summoned. It seems to be related to a case of robbery. The principal of Teitan Elementary says that ten years ago, the police had come to their school to investigate a robbery nearby.
